name: webdevnerdstuff
description: All of WebDevNerdStuff's Claude Code mods and skills in one marketplace: add it once, install any of them.

owner.name: WebDevNerdStuff & Bunnies... lots and lots of bunnies!

plugins.name: gac
plugins.description: Git add and commit in one step, with shorthands that push, open a PR, merge it once you confirm, and publish a release. GitHub, Bitbucket Cloud and self-hosted Forgejo/Gitea. /gac, /gacp, /gacpp, /gacppm, /gacppmr.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Copy-paste session handoff summaries for continuing work or reporting completion. /handoff writes one, or automatically before an idle session's cache expires.

plugins.name: loadout
plugins.description: Everything Claude Code has equipped, in one pane: your local, project, plugin and claude.ai account skills, and every enabled plugin. What each skill does, where it lives, whether it is off. /loadout opens it.

plugins.name: session-mover
plugins.description: Move Claude desktop Code sessions between sidebar workspaces from a pane. /move-sessions opens it.

plugins.name: skin-code
plugins.description: Real syntax highlighting for code blocks in Claude Code replies: VS Code's grammars and themes through Shiki, following your skins skin or a theme you pick. /skin-code switches it.
